# openobserve_organization (Data Source)

Reads an OpenObserve organization by its identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_organization" "default" {
  identifier = "default"
}

output "org_name" {
  value = data.openobserve_organization.default.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Organization identifier (e.g. `default`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID, same as `identifier`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable organization name.
- `type` (Number) Organization type code returned by the API.
- `user_email` (String) Email of the user who created or owns this organization.
